newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: MLC sells building society unit to NRMA.
newsitem.headline: MLC sells building society unit to NRMA.

text.p: Lend Lease Corp Ltd unit MLC Ltd said on Thursday it had sold its building society to the National Roads and Motorists Association (NRMA) for an undisclosed sum.
MLC said the sale was for a competitive price and that NRMA would continue to employ all of the society's existing staff.

"Strong interest in acquiring the building society meant we will be able to meet our objectives with a good price, a smooth transition for investors and customers, and continuing employment for all employees," MLC chief executive David Clarke said in a statement.
The sale of the building society, announced in May, was part of MLC's strategy of focusing on its growing funds management business, Clarke said.

MLC said in May that the margins in the competitive market were no longer attractive when compared with its funds management business. The MLC building society was the fifth largest in Australia, but a small unit with MLC, it added.
The sale is subject to regulatory approval. A meeting of members would be held in early August with the aim of completing the sale soon after.
